prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1482; do not mention it.)
text:
This summary is for a synthetic test record and contains no real patient information.

Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped during a lane change. The patient reported immediate onset of neck pain with radiation to the trapezius region and low back pain with stiffness on waking. Examination revealed restricted cervical range of motion, paraspinal muscle tenderness in the cervical and lumbar regions, and no focal neurological deficits. Imaging was not indicated at initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag findings.

Conservative management was initiated and consisted of manual therapy, therapeutic exercise focused on core and cervical stabilization, modalities for pain control, and a home exercise program. The patient attended a total of 14 visits over the course of treatment. Progress was steady, with gradual improvement in range of motion, reduced pain intensity, and improved tolerance for daily activities.

At discharge, the patient demonstrated near-baseline cervical and lumbar mobility with mild residual stiffness. The patient was instructed to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsen or new neurological symptoms develop.
